build_lasso_lars_ic_pipeline: build a scikit-learn pipeline that fits LassoLarsIC with StandardScaler for AIC model selection
build_lasso_lars_ic_bic: build a scikit-learn pipeline that fits LassoLarsIC with StandardScaler for BIC model selection
test_zou_et_al_criterion_rescaling: test the zou_et_al_criterion_rescaling function to rescale AIC and BIC information criteria
run_load_diabetes_dataset: run load_diabetes to load the diabetes dataset as a pandas DataFrame
run_plot_lasso_criteria: run plotting code that displays AIC and BIC criterion values with selected alpha line
